chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Three things contain that which is detested by Allah, Mighty and Majestic: sleeping without wakefulness, laughing without wonder, and eating while full.

key_terms.عَجَبٍ: wonder or a cause for amazement

ai.seo_question: Which behaviors are described in hadith as hateful to Allah, Mighty and Majestic?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that certain forms of excess, heedlessness, and lack of seriousness are hateful to Allah, Mighty and Majestic. It warns against unnecessary sleep, laughter without cause, and eating beyond satiety as blameworthy traits of conduct.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Three things bring forth the dislike (anger) of Allah (swt), the Almighty and Majestic: sleeping without fatigue, laughing without wonder, and eating when already full”.
